title: DOQS parts-library marker
description: library.toml at the root of a parts library: a repository recording parts other people design, make and sell. The marker, not the mount path, is what identifies one, so a machine may mount a library anywhere under modules/ and still skip it in its own gates. Inside a library a manifest declares CC-BY-SA-4.0 rather than CERN-OHL-S-2.0, because the record is ours and the parts are not.

name.description: The library's own name, used as the first part of a part reference: stoq:hiwin/hgr-rail#HGR20R500.
